만나서 반갑습니다.forms: polite: 만나서 반가워요 · casual: 만나서 반가워
만나서 반갑습니다.m: nice to meet you, glad to meet you
만나서 반갑습니다.x: Nice to meet you. I'm from the United States.
만나서 반갑습니다.e: 만나다 (to meet) + 반갑다 (glad to see someone) — 'having met you, I'm glad'.

아침.t: 아침, 점심, 저녁 are both times of day and meals: 아침 먹었어요? = Did you eat breakfast?

놀다.forms: 놀아요 · 놀았어요 · 놀 거예요 · 노세요 (ㄹ drops)
놀다.m: to play, to hang out; to be off (work)
놀다.x: I hung out at my friend's house on the weekend.
놀다.e: 놀이 = play, game; 놀이공원 = amusement park. 놀러 오세요 = come hang out.
놀다.t: 놀다 is not for sports or instruments: use 하다 (축구를 하다) or 치다 (피아노를 치다).

내려가다.x: I take the elevator down to the first floor.
내려가다.e: 내리다 (come down, get off) + 가다 (go); 내려오다 = come down. Opposite: 올라가다.

불편하다.x: This chair is a little uncomfortable.

피부.ex: 제 언니는 피부가 하얗고 정말 좋아요.
피부.x: My older sister has fair, really nice skin.

편안하다.x: It's really comfortable when I sit on this sofa.

풀다.forms: 풀어요 · 풀었어요 · 풀 거예요 · 푸세요 (ㄹ drops)
풀다.m: to untie, to unpack; to solve; to relieve (stress)
풀다.ex: 호텔에 도착하자마자 짐을 풀고 좀 쉬었어요.
풀다.x: As soon as I got to the hotel, I unpacked and rested a bit.
풀다.e: Core idea: loosening — knots, bags, problems, even stress.
풀다.t: 스트레스를 풀다 'to relieve stress' and 문제를 풀다 'to solve a problem' are very common.

계단.x: The elevator was broken, so I went up the stairs.
계단.t: In everyday speech it's usually pronounced [게단]; ㅖ after a consonant often sounds like ㅔ.

근무하다.m: to work, to be on duty, to serve
근무하다.ex: 제 형은 은행에서 오 년 동안 근무했어요.
근무하다.x: My older brother worked at a bank for five years.
근무하다.e: Literally 'diligent tasks': working at a job.
근무하다.t: More formal than 일하다; common on job ads and forms: 근무 시간, 근무 장소.

만두.x: I made dumplings with my family on Lunar New Year.
만두.e: From a Chinese word for 'steamed bun'; in Korea it means filled dumplings.

주변.x: There's a convenience store and a park around my house.
주변.e: Literally 'around the edges' — the surrounding area.

리터.ex: 물은 하루에 2리터 정도 마시는 게 좋대요.
리터.x: They say it's good to drink about 2 liters of water a day.
리터.t: Decimals are read with 점 'point': 1.5리터 = 일 점 오 리터.

수출.x: Korea exports a lot of cars every year.
수출.t: The opposite is 수입 'import' — a different 수입 from 'income'.

외과.x: I hurt my leg, so I got treated in the surgery department.
외과.t: For sprains and bone or joint pain, Koreans usually go to 정형외과 (orthopedics).

구조.ex: 이 집은 구조가 좋아서 방이 넓어 보여요.
구조.x: This place has a good layout, so the rooms look spacious.
구조.t: A different 구조 means 'rescue,' as in 구조대 'rescue team.'

위로하다.x: I warmly comforted my friend who failed the exam.

결코.ex: 저는 결코 꿈을 포기하지 않을 거예요.
결코.x: I will never give up on my dream.
결코.t: 결코 sounds stronger and more formal than 절대; it almost always takes a negative.

구분하다.m: to distinguish, to tell apart; to divide, to classify
구분하다.x: They're twins, so it's hard to tell the two apart.

진단.ex: 병원에 갔는데 의사에게 감기라는 진단을 받았어요.
진단.x: I went to the clinic, and the doctor diagnosed me with a cold.

사기.ex: 요즘 전화로 하는 사기가 많으니까 조심하세요.
사기.x: There are a lot of phone scams these days, so be careful.
사기.e: Literally 'deceiving and cheating.' Homonym warning: 사기 also means 'morale.'
사기.t: 사기를 당하다 means 'to get scammed'; 사기를 치다 means 'to scam someone.'

신뢰하다.m: to trust, to have faith in
신뢰하다.x: Our team members deeply trust one another.
신뢰하다.t: Pronounced [실뢰하다]: ㄴ becomes ㄹ before ㄹ.

그런데도.forms: A. 그런데도 B. (formal written: 그럼에도 불구하고)
그런데도.m: even so, despite that, and yet
그런데도.ex: 열이 많이 났어요. 그런데도 그는 회사에 갔어요.
그런데도.x: He had a high fever. Even so, he went to work.
그런데도.t: Stronger than 그래도: it stresses that the result goes against what you'd expect.

튀다.m: to splash, spatter; to bounce; to stand out
튀다.x: A car went by and muddy water splashed on my clothes.

에이.forms: 에이! · 에이, 설마 · 에이, 아니에요 (modest denial)
에이.m: come on, no way, aw (doubt, dismissal or mild disappointment)
에이.x: Oh, come on, is that really true?
에이.e: An interjection of doubt or mild letdown, close to English 'aw, come on'.
에이.t: Also brushes off praise modestly: 에이, 아니에요 'Oh no, not at all.' Stretched 에이~ sounds teasing.

수천.x: Thousands of people gathered at the weekend festival.
수천.t: For tens of thousands, Korean uses 수만 ('several 만'), not '수십 천'.

자살.ex: 정부는 자살을 예방하기 위해 상담 전화를 운영합니다.
자살.x: The government runs a counseling hotline to prevent suicide.

비난하다.m: to criticize, to blame, to condemn
비난하다.ex: 많은 사람들이 그 정치인의 발언을 비난했어요.
비난하다.x: Many people criticized the politician's remarks.
비난하다.e: Literally 'calling something wrong and reproaching it'.
비난하다.t: 비난 is an emotional attack on a person; 비판 is a reasoned critique of ideas or policies.

취재.ex: 기자들이 사고 현장에서 취재를 하고 있어요.
취재.x: Reporters are covering the story at the accident scene.
취재.t: 취재 is collecting the information; 보도 is publishing or airing it.

유전.ex: 키는 유전의 영향을 많이 받는다고 해요.
유전.x: They say height is strongly influenced by genetics.
유전.e: Literally 'left behind and passed on'. Homonym: 유전 'oil field'.
유전.t: For diseases, use 유전되다: 이 병은 유전돼요 'This disease is hereditary.'

음원.x: These days I listen to music tracks by streaming.
음원.e: Literally 'sound source'; now mostly means a digital or streaming track.

무심하다.ex: 바쁘다고 부모님께 너무 무심했던 것 같아요.
무심하다.x: I think I've been too neglectful of my parents because I was busy.
무심하다.e: Literally 'without heart' — not paying attention to others' feelings.

열의.x: The students' eagerness to study is remarkable.
열의.t: Pronounced [여리] — 의 after a consonant is usually said like 이.

유연하다.x: If you do yoga regularly, your body becomes flexible.

매번.x: He's late for our appointments every time.

달아나다.m: to run away, to flee, to escape
달아나다.x: The thief saw the police and quickly ran away.

찌푸리다.m: to frown, grimace; to be overcast (sky)
찌푸리다.ex: 그는 이상한 냄새 때문에 얼굴을 찌푸렸어요.
찌푸리다.x: He frowned because of the strange smell.

퍼뜨리다.x: Who spread such a strange rumor?
퍼뜨리다.e: 퍼지다 'to spread' + -뜨리다, which makes it active.

인과.x: I think everything has a cause and effect.
인과.e: Literally 'cause and fruit': the seed and what grows from it.
인과.t: Pronounced [인꽈]; it usually appears in 인과 관계 rather than alone.

사찰.ex: 이 사찰은 천 년이 넘는 역사를 가지고 있습니다.
사찰.x: This temple has a history of over a thousand years.
사찰.e: A formal word for 절; the second syllable comes from a Sanskrit word for a sacred site.
사찰.t: Everyday speech says 절; its homonym 사찰 means 'inspection, surveillance'.

피란.ex: 전쟁 때 할머니 가족은 부산으로 피란을 갔어요.
피란.x: During the war, my grandmother's family fled to Busan.
피란.t: 피란 is fleeing war specifically; 피난 is fleeing any disaster, but many people use 피난 for both.

산화.ex: 사과를 자르고 두면 산화 때문에 색이 변해요.
산화.x: If you leave a cut apple out, its color changes because of oxidation.
산화.e: 산 from 산소 'oxygen' + -화 '-ization' — combining with oxygen.

외주.x: We decided to outsource the design work.

대두되다.m: to emerge, to come to the fore, to arise (as an issue)
대두되다.ex: 최근 환경 문제가 중요한 사회 문제로 대두되었습니다.
대두되다.x: Recently, environmental problems have emerged as an important social issue.
대두되다.e: Literally 'lifting its head' — an issue rears up.
대두되다.t: Homonym warning: 대두 (大豆) also means soybean.

기술하다.m: to describe (in writing), to give an account of
기술하다.ex: 이 책은 조선 시대의 생활을 자세히 기술하고 있습니다.
기술하다.x: This book describes life in the Joseon era in detail.
기술하다.t: A homonym 기술 (different hanja) means 'technology, skill' and is far more common in speech.

거론하다.m: to bring up, to raise (for discussion)
거론하다.ex: 회의에서 아무도 그 문제를 거론하지 않았어요.
거론하다.x: No one brought up that issue at the meeting.

출범하다.m: to launch, to be inaugurated (a government, organization)
출범하다.x: The new administration was officially launched today.
출범하다.e: Literally 'set sail' — a new organization leaving port.

은폐하다.ex: 회사는 사고 사실을 은폐하려다가 결국 들통났습니다.
은폐하다.x: The company tried to cover up the accident but was eventually caught.

날조하다.m: to fabricate, to make up (false facts)
날조하다.ex: 그 기자는 인터뷰 내용을 날조한 사실이 밝혀졌습니다.
날조하다.x: It was revealed that the reporter had fabricated the interview.
날조하다.e: Literally 'knead and make' — shaping a story out of nothing.

고조되다.m: to rise, to heighten, to build up (tension, mood)
고조되다.ex: 결승전이 다가오면서 응원 열기가 점점 고조되고 있어요.
고조되다.x: As the final approaches, the excitement among fans is building.

과열되다.ex: 부동산 시장이 과열되자 정부가 대책을 내놓았습니다.
과열되다.x: When the real estate market overheated, the government announced measures.

포괄하다.m: to encompass, to include, to cover broadly
포괄하다.ex: 새 법안은 다양한 형태의 고용을 포괄합니다.
포괄하다.x: The new bill covers various forms of employment.

도태되다.m: to be weeded out, to be eliminated, to fall behind and drop out
도태되다.ex: 변화에 적응하지 못하는 기업은 도태될 수밖에 없습니다.
도태되다.x: Companies that can't adapt to change are bound to be weeded out.
도태되다.e: Literally 'washed and sifted' — like panning, where the lighter grains get washed away.
도태되다.t: In biology, 자연 도태 means 'natural selection'.

천진난만하다.x: The children's innocent laughter came from the playground.
천진난만하다.e: Literally 'naturally true and brimming over' — pure, unspoiled spirit.

폐해.ex: 지나친 경쟁의 폐해가 점점 커지고 있습니다.
폐해.x: The harmful effects of excessive competition are growing.

고비.m: critical moment, the hardest part, a crisis point
고비.ex: 이번 주만 잘 넘기면 큰 고비는 지나가요.
고비.x: If we just get through this week, the worst will be behind us.
고비.e: Also used for an age milestone: 마흔 고비 'pushing forty'.

타이르다.forms: 타일러요 · 타일렀어요 · 타이를 거예요 · 타이르세요 (르 irregular)
타이르다.m: to gently admonish, to reason with, to talk someone into behaving
타이르다.x: The mother gently talked to the crying child.
타이르다.e: A native word for a calm, patient talking-to — much softer than 꾸짖다.
타이르다.t: As a 르 irregular, it becomes 타일러요, not 타이러요.

사죄하다.m: to apologize formally, to beg forgiveness
사죄하다.ex: 회사 대표가 피해자들에게 머리 숙여 사죄했습니다.
사죄하다.x: The company's CEO bowed his head and apologized to the victims.
사죄하다.t: 사죄 implies serious wrongdoing; for everyday mistakes use 사과하다 or 죄송합니다.

빈소.m: funeral altar room, memorial room for mourners
빈소.x: A memorial room for the deceased has been set up at the funeral hall.
빈소.e: Literally 'place where the coffin lies before burial'.
빈소.t: Usually a room at a hospital funeral hall where mourners bow before a photo of the deceased, typically over three days.

지니계수.x: The closer the Gini coefficient is to 1, the worse income inequality is.
지니계수.e: Named after Italian statistician Corrado Gini; 계수 means 'coefficient'.

단리.x: This savings plan calculates interest as simple interest.
단리.e: Literally 'single interest' — paid only on the original principal.
단리.t: Pronounced [달리] — the ㄴ turns into ㄹ before ㄹ.

여소야대.m: divided government (a ruling party in the minority, opposition in the majority)
여소야대.ex: 여소야대 국회에서는 법안 통과가 쉽지 않아요.
여소야대.x: With the opposition controlling the National Assembly, passing bills isn't easy.
여소야대.t: 여 = 여당 and 야 = 야당; news uses this pair constantly, as in 여야 (both parties).

진상규명.x: The bereaved families are demanding that the truth about the accident be uncovered.
진상규명.e: Literally 'investigating until the true picture is clear'.

토속신앙.ex: 마을 입구의 장승은 토속신앙과 관련이 있어요.
토속신앙.x: The totem poles at the village entrance are tied to folk religion.
토속신앙.e: Literally 'local-custom faith' — beliefs rooted in the land.
토속신앙.t: Pronounced [토속씨낭] — ㅅ tenses after ㄱ, and ㄴ links into 앙.

최빈값.ex: 이 반에서 가장 자주 나온 점수인 최빈값은 80점이에요.
최빈값.x: The mode, the score that came up most often in this class, is 80.
최빈값.e: 최빈 (most frequent) + native 값 (value): 'the most frequent value'.
최빈값.t: Pronounced [최빈깝] — 값 is tensed after a noun.

신경망.ex: 인공 신경망은 사람의 뇌를 흉내 낸 기술입니다.
신경망.x: An artificial neural network is a technology that imitates the human brain.

웨어러블.ex: 스마트워치 같은 웨어러블 기기가 인기를 끌고 있어요.
웨어러블.x: Wearable devices like smartwatches are gaining popularity.
웨어러블.t: Usually followed by 기기 or 기술: 웨어러블 기기.

우화.ex: 이솝 우화에는 동물이 주인공인 이야기가 많아요.
우화.x: Aesop's Fables has many stories where animals are the main characters.
우화.e: Literally 'lodged talk' — a lesson lodged inside a story, often about animals.

교열.m: copyediting, checking a text for errors and accuracy
교열.ex: 이 원고는 교열 과정에서 많은 오류가 고쳐졌어요.
교열.x: Many errors in this manuscript were fixed during copyediting.
교열.e: Literally 'check and review' — goes deeper than proofreading, covering facts and wording.

뉴미디어.ex: 젊은 세대는 주로 뉴미디어를 통해 뉴스를 접합니다.
뉴미디어.x: Younger generations mostly get their news through new media.

선연하다.m: vivid, clear (as if seen right now)
선연하다.x: The memory of that day is still vivid before my eyes.
선연하다.e: Literally 'fresh-looking' — as vivid as if it were happening now.

삼가.forms: 삼가 + humble verb: 삼가 명복을 빕니다 · 삼가 아룁니다
삼가.ex: 갑작스러운 비보에 고인의 명복을 삼가 빕니다.
삼가.x: At this sudden sad news, I humbly pray for the repose of the deceased.
삼가.t: 삼가 고인의 명복을 빕니다 is the standard condolence message.

쾌도난마.m: cutting through a mess decisively, solving a tangled problem swiftly
쾌도난마.ex: 새 사장은 회사 문제를 쾌도난마로 해결했어요.
쾌도난마.x: The new president cut through the company's problems decisively.
쾌도난마.e: Literally 'a sharp knife through tangled hemp.'
